turns.study: Perdone, mi vuelo a París está cancelado. ¿Qué podemos hacer?
turns.phon: pehr-DOH-neh, MEE VOOEH-loh AH pah-REES ehs-TAH kahn-seh-LAH-doh. KEH poh-DEH-mohs ah-SEHR
turns.native: Excuse me, my flight to Paris is cancelled. What can we do?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Lo siento. Puede que haya otro vuelo esta noche.
turns.phon: LOH SEEEHN-toh. POOEH-deh KEH AH-yah OH-troh VOOEH-loh EHS-tah NOH-cheh
turns.native: I'm sorry. There might be another flight tonight.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: ¿Y si no hay?
turns.phon: EE SEE NOH AHEE
turns.native: And if there isn't?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: En ese caso, le ponemos en el vuelo de mañana y le pagamos el hotel.
turns.phon: EHN EH-seh KAH-soh, LEH poh-NEH-mohs EHN EHL VOOEH-loh DEH mah-NYAH-nah EE LEH pah-GAH-mohs EHL oh-TEHL
turns.native: In that case, we put you on tomorrow's flight and pay for your hotel.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Si he entendido bien, tengo que esperar aquí, ¿no?
turns.phon: SEE EH ehn-tehn-DEE-doh BEEEHN, TEHN-goh KEH ehs-peh-RAHR ah-KEE, NOH
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I have to wait here, right?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Más bien no. Puede ir al hotel y le avisamos por teléfono.
turns.phon: MAHS BEEEHN NOH. POOEH-deh EER AHL oh-TEHL EE LEH ah-vee-SAH-mohs POHR teh-LEH-foh-noh
turns.native: Not really. You can go to the hotel and we'll let you know by phone.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Vale. Lo que quiero decir es que necesito llegar antes del lunes.
turns.phon: VAH-leh. LOH KEH KEEEH-roh deh-SEER EHS KEH neh-seh-SEE-toh yeh-GAHR AHN-tehs DEHL LOO-nehs
turns.native: OK. What I mean is that I need to get there before Monday.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Lo entiendo. Quizás hay una plaza esta noche; vuelva en una hora.
turns.phon: LOH ehn-TEEEHN-doh. kee-SAHS AHEE OO-nah PLAH-sah EHS-tah NOH-cheh, VOOEHL-vah EHN OO-nah OH-rah
turns.native: I understand. Maybe there's a seat tonight; come back in an hour.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: De acuerdo, gracias.
turns.phon: DEH ah-KOOEHR-doh, GRAH-seeahs
turns.native: All right, thank you.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Buenos días. ¿Qué le pasa?
turns.phon: BOOEH-nohs DEE-ahs. KEH LEH PAH-sah
turns.native: Good morning. What's the matter?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Me duele la garganta y la cabeza desde hace dos días.
turns.phon: MEH DOOEH-leh LAH gahr-GAHN-tah EE LAH kah-BEH-sah DEHS-deh AH-seh DOHS DEE-ahs
turns.native: My throat and my head have been hurting for two days.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: ¿Tiene fiebre?
turns.phon: TEEEH-neh FEEEH-breh
turns.native: Do you have a fever?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: No mucho. Un poco por la noche.
turns.phon: NOH MOO-choh. OON POH-koh POHR LAH NOH-cheh
turns.native: Not much. A little at night.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Puede que sea un virus. Le voy a recetar algo.
turns.phon: POOEH-deh KEH SEH-ah OON VEE-roos. LEH VOHEE AH reh-seh-TAHR AHL-goh
turns.native: It might be a virus. I'm going to prescribe you something.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Si he entendido bien, no es grave, ¿no?
turns.phon: SEE EH ehn-tehn-DEE-doh BEEEHN, NOH EHS GRAH-veh, NOH
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, it's not serious, right?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: No, pero es mejor descansar dos o tres días.
turns.phon: NOH, PEH-roh EHS meh-KHOHR dehs-kahn-SAHR DOHS OH TREHS DEE-ahs
turns.native: No, but it's best to rest for two or three days.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Hay un problema: mañana tengo que trabajar.
turns.phon: AHEE OON proh-BLEH-mah, mah-NYAH-nah TEHN-goh KEH trah-bah-KHAHR
turns.native: There's a problem: tomorrow I have to work.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Le hago un justificante. En parte depende de usted: descanse.
turns.phon: LEH AH-goh OON khoos-tee-fee-KAHN-teh. EHN PAHR-teh deh-PEHN-deh DEH oos-TEHD, dehs-KAHN-seh
turns.native: I'll write you a sick note. It partly depends on you: rest.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Gracias, doctor.
turns.phon: GRAH-seeahs, dohk-TOHR
turns.native: Thank you, doctor.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Buenos días, vengo a renovar mi tarjeta.
turns.phon: BOOEH-nohs DEE-ahs, VEHN-goh AH reh-noh-VAHR MEE tahr-KHEH-tah
turns.native: Good morning, I've come to renew my card.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: A ver… Falta un documento: el justificante de domicilio.
turns.phon: AH VEHR. FAHL-tah OON doh-koo-MEHN-toh, EHL khoos-tee-fee-KAHN-teh DEH doh-mee-SEE-leeoh
turns.native: Let's see… A document is missing: the proof of address.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Es decir, ¿una factura de la luz?
turns.phon: EHS deh-SEER, OO-nah fahk-TOO-rah DEH LAH LOOS
turns.native: In other words, an electricity bill?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Sí, o del agua.
turns.phon: SEE, OH DEHL AH-gooah
turns.native: Yes, or a water bill.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Puede que la tenga en el móvil. Un momento… Aquí está.
turns.phon: POOEH-deh KEH LAH TEHN-gah EHN EHL MOH-veel. OON moh-MEHN-toh. ah-KEE ehs-TAH
turns.native: I might have it on my phone. One moment… Here it is.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Perfecto. Pero no estoy seguro de la fecha: es de hace cuatro meses.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHK-toh. PEH-roh NOH ehs-TOHEE seh-GOO-roh DEH LAH FEH-chah, EHS DEH AH-seh KOOAH-troh MEH-sehs
turns.native: Perfect. But I'm not sure about the date: it's from four months ago.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: ¿Qué podemos hacer en este caso?
turns.phon: KEH poh-DEH-mohs ah-SEHR EHN EHS-teh KAH-soh
turns.native: What can we do in this case?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Más bien, tráigame una de este mes. Puede volver mañana sin cita.
turns.phon: MAHS BEEEHN, TRAHEE-gah-meh OO-nah DEH EHS-teh MEHS. POOEH-deh vohl-VEHR mah-NYAH-nah SEEN SEE-tah
turns.native: Actually, bring me one from this month. You can come back tomorrow without an appointment.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Si he entendido bien, vuelvo mañana con la factura, ¿no?
turns.phon: SEE EH ehn-tehn-DEE-doh BEEEHN, VOOEHL-voh mah-NYAH-nah KOHN LAH fahk-TOO-rah, NOH
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I come back tomorrow with the bill, right?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Exacto. Hasta mañana.
turns.phon: ehk-SAHK-toh. AHS-tah mah-NYAH-nah
turns.native: Exactly. See you tomorrow.
turns.speaker: B

turns.native: Of course, I'll change it for you right away, no supplement.

turns.study: Buongiorno, dottore. Ho mal di gola e la febbre da ieri.
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, doht-TOH-reh. oh mahl dee GOH-lah eh lah FEHB-breh dah YEH-ree
turns.native: Good morning, doctor. I've had a sore throat and a fever since yesterday.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Vediamo. Ha anche la tosse?
turns.phon: veh-DYAH-moh. ah AHN-keh lah TOHS-seh
turns.native: Let's see. Do you have a cough too?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Non proprio, solo un po' la sera.
turns.phon: nohn PROH-pryoh, SOH-loh oon poh lah SEH-rah
turns.native: Not really, just a little in the evening.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Può darsi che sia solo un'influenza.
turns.phon: pwoh DAR-see keh SEE-ah SOH-loh oo-neen-floo-EHN-tsah
turns.native: It may just be the flu.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Cioè, non è grave?
turns.phon: choh-EH, nohn eh GRAH-veh
turns.native: I mean, it's not serious?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: No. Riposo, molta acqua e queste compresse per cinque giorni.
turns.phon: noh. ree-POH-zoh, MOHL-tah AH-kwah eh KWEHS-teh kohm-PREHS-seh pehr CHEEN-kweh JOR-nee
turns.native: No. Rest, plenty of water and these tablets for five days.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Se ho capito bene, una compressa al giorno?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, OO-nah kohm-PREHS-sah ahl JOR-noh
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, one tablet a day?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Due: una la mattina e una la sera. Se non migliora, torni tra una settimana.
turns.phon: DOO-eh: OO-nah lah maht-TEE-nah eh OO-nah lah SEH-rah. seh nohn mee-LYOH-rah, TOR-nee trah OO-nah seht-tee-MAH-nah
turns.native: Two: one in the morning and one in the evening. If it doesn't improve, come back in a week.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Grazie, dottore.
turns.phon: GRAH-tsyeh, doht-TOH-reh
turns.native: Thank you, doctor.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Marco, c'è un problema: il cliente dice che la consegna era per oggi.
turns.phon: MAR-koh, cheh oon proh-BLEH-mah: eel klee-EHN-teh DEE-cheh keh lah kohn-SEH-nyah EH-rah pehr OHD-jee
turns.native: Marco, there's a problem: the client says the delivery was for today.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Come? Io avevo capito venerdì.
turns.phon: KOH-meh. EE-oh ah-VEH-voh kah-PEE-toh veh-nehr-DEE
turns.native: What? I'd understood Friday.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Forse c'è stato un errore nella mail.
turns.phon: FOR-seh cheh STAH-toh oon ehr-ROH-reh NEHL-lah MAYL
turns.native: Maybe there was a mistake in the email.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Può darsi. Quello che voglio dire è che non è colpa nostra.
turns.phon: pwoh DAR-see. KWEHL-loh keh VOH-lyoh DEE-reh eh keh nohn eh KOHL-pah NOHS-trah
turns.native: Could be. What I mean is that it's not our fault.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: In parte sì, in parte no. Cosa possiamo fare?
turns.phon: een PAR-teh SEE, een PAR-teh noh. KOH-zah pohs-SYAH-moh FAH-reh
turns.native: Partly yes, partly no. What can we do?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Possiamo consegnare una prima parte oggi e il resto venerdì.
turns.phon: pohs-SYAH-moh kohn-seh-NYAH-reh OO-nah PREE-mah PAR-teh OHD-jee eh eel REHS-toh veh-nehr-DEE
turns.native: We can deliver a first part today and the rest on Friday.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Se ho capito bene, chiamo il cliente e gli propongo questo?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, KYAH-moh eel klee-EHN-teh eh lyee proh-POHN-goh KWEHS-toh
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I call the client and suggest this?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Esatto. E ci scusiamo per il malinteso.
turns.phon: eh-ZAHT-toh. eh chee skoo-ZYAH-moh pehr eel mah-leen-TEH-zoh
turns.native: Exactly. And we apologise for the misunderstanding.
turns.speaker: B

files.goal: Hold a conversation mixing narrative, opinion, argument and clarification.

longestVariant.study: Da un lato è una bella città, dall'altro costa troppo.
longestVariant.phon: dah oon LAH-toh eh OO-nah BEHL-lah cheet-TAH, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
longestVariant.native: On the one hand it's a beautiful city, on the other it costs too much.

longestTurn.study: Ti capisco. Quando sono arrivato a Torino, i primi mesi sono stati duri. Poi ho trovato degli amici.
longestTurn.phon: tee kah-PEES-koh. KWAHN-doh SOH-noh ar-ree-VAH-toh ah toh-REE-noh, ee PREE-mee MEH-zee SOH-noh STAH-tee DOO-ree. POY oh troh-VAH-toh DEH-lyee ah-MEE-chee
longestTurn.native: I understand. When I arrived in Turin, the first months were hard. Then I made some friends.

units.frame: Da un lato {s}, dall'altro costa troppo.

firstVariant.study: Da un lato mi piace molto, dall'altro costa troppo.
firstVariant.phon: dah oon LAH-toh mee PYAH-cheh MOHL-toh, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
firstVariant.native: On the one hand I really like it, on the other it costs too much.

lastVariant.study: Da un lato è vicino al mare, dall'altro costa troppo.
lastVariant.phon: dah oon LAH-toh eh vee-CHEE-noh ahl MAH-reh, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
lastVariant.native: On the one hand it's near the sea, on the other it costs too much.

firstVariant.study: È vero, ma non è così semplice.
firstVariant.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah nohn eh koh-ZEE SEHM-plee-cheh
firstVariant.native: That's true, but it's not that simple.

lastVariant.study: È vero, ma non abbiamo scelta.
lastVariant.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah nohn ahb-BYAH-moh SHEHL-tah
lastVariant.native: That's true, but we have no choice.

units.frame: Se ho capito bene, pensi che {s}.

firstVariant.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che sia troppo tardi.
firstVariant.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh SEE-ah TROHP-poh TAR-dee
firstVariant.native: If I've understood correctly, you think it's too late.

lastVariant.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che io abbia torto.
lastVariant.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh EE-oh AHB-byah TOR-toh
lastVariant.native: If I've understood correctly, you think I'm wrong.

lastVariant.study: In sintesi, dobbiamo decidere entro venerdì.
lastVariant.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, dohb-BYAH-moh deh-CHEE-deh-reh EHN-troh veh-nehr-DEE
lastVariant.native: In short, we have to decide by Friday.

firstVariant.native: Well, I have to go. See you soon!

lastVariant.native: Say hi to everyone!

firstVariant.study: Quando sono arrivato a Roma, ero felicissimo.
firstVariant.phon: KWAHN-doh SOH-noh ar-ree-VAH-toh ah ROH-mah, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-moh
firstVariant.native: When I arrived in Rome, I was over the moon.

lastVariant.study: Quando è nata mia figlia, ero felicissimo.
lastVariant.phon: KWAHN-doh eh NAH-tah MEE-ah FEE-lyah, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-moh
lastVariant.native: When my daughter was born, I was over the moon.

firstVariant.study: Sono convinto che sia la scelta giusta.
firstVariant.phon: SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh SEE-ah lah SHEHL-tah JOOS-tah
firstVariant.native: I'm convinced it's the right choice.

lastVariant.study: Sono convinto che abbiamo fatto bene.
lastVariant.phon: SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh ahb-BYAH-moh FAHT-toh BEH-neh
lastVariant.native: I'm convinced we did the right thing.

firstVariant.native: You're right, but it costs too much.

lastVariant.study: Hai ragione, però non sono convinto.
lastVariant.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH nohn SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh
lastVariant.native: You're right, but I'm not convinced.

firstVariant.native: Do you mean you're not coming?

lastVariant.study: Vuoi dire che hai cambiato idea?
lastVariant.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh AH-ee kahm-BYAH-toh ee-DEH-ah
lastVariant.native: Do you mean you've changed your mind?

firstVariant.native: By the way, have you heard from Marco?

lastVariant.study: A proposito, hai visto la partita?
lastVariant.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, AH-ee VEES-toh lah par-TEE-tah
lastVariant.native: By the way, did you see the match?
It was completely full.

firstVariant.study: Il problema è che costa troppo.
firstVariant.phon: eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
firstVariant.native: The problem is that it costs too much.

lastVariant.study: Il problema è che nessuno è d'accordo.
lastVariant.phon: eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh nehs-SOO-noh eh dahk-KOR-doh
lastVariant.native: The problem is that nobody agrees.
Anyway, thanks for everything.

turns.study: Allora, hai deciso? Vai a vivere a Milano?
turns.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, AH-ee deh-CHEE-zoh. VAH-ee ah VEE-veh-reh ah mee-LAH-noh
turns.native: So, have you decided? Are you going to live in Milan?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Non ancora. Da un lato è un'ottima occasione, dall'altro tutta la mia vita è qui.
turns.phon: nohn ahn-KOH-rah. dah oon LAH-toh eh oo-NOHT-tee-mah ohk-kah-ZYOH-neh, dahl-LAHL-troh TOOT-tah lah MEE-ah VEE-tah eh KWEE
turns.native: Not yet. On the one hand it's a great opportunity, on the other my whole life is here.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: È vero, ma un lavoro così non capita tutti i giorni.
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah oon lah-VOH-roh koh-ZEE nohn KAH-pee-tah TOOT-tee ee JOR-nee
turns.native: That's true, but a job like that doesn't come along every day.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Lo so. Il problema è che Milano è cara e non conosco nessuno.
turns.phon: loh SOH. eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh mee-LAH-noh eh KAH-rah eh nohn koh-NOHS-koh nehs-SOO-noh
turns.native: I know. The problem is that Milan is expensive and I don't know anyone.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che sia troppo rischioso?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh SEE-ah TROHP-poh rees-KYOH-zoh
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, you think it's too risky?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Non proprio. Ho paura di sentirmi solo, soprattutto all'inizio.
turns.phon: nohn PROH-pryoh. oh pah-OO-rah dee sehn-TEER-mee SOH-loh, soh-praht-TOOT-toh ahl-lee-NEE-tsyoh
turns.native: Not really. I'm afraid of feeling lonely, especially at the start.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Ti capisco. Quando sono arrivato a Torino, i primi mesi sono stati duri. Poi ho trovato degli amici.
turns.phon: tee kah-PEES-koh. KWAHN-doh SOH-noh ar-ree-VAH-toh ah toh-REE-noh, ee PREE-mee MEH-zee SOH-noh STAH-tee DOO-ree. POY oh troh-VAH-toh DEH-lyee ah-MEE-chee
turns.native: I understand. When I arrived in Turin, the first months were hard. Then I made some friends.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Hai ragione, però tu eri più giovane.
turns.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH too EH-ree pyoo JOH-vah-neh
turns.native: You're right, but you were younger.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: In sintesi, hai ancora bisogno di tempo. Ne parliamo la settimana prossima?
turns.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, AH-ee ahn-KOH-rah bee-ZOH-nyoh dee TEHM-poh. neh par-LYAH-moh lah seht-tee-MAH-nah PROHS-see-mah
turns.native: In short, you still need time. Shall we talk about it next week?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Sì, grazie. Beh, devo andare. A presto!
turns.phon: SEE, GRAH-tsyeh. beh, DEH-voh ahn-DAH-reh. ah PREHS-toh
turns.native: Yes, thanks. Well, I have to go. See you soon!
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Bentornata! Com'è andato il viaggio in Sicilia?
turns.phon: behn-tor-NAH-tah. koh-MEH ahn-DAH-toh eel VYAHD-joh een see-CHEE-lyah
turns.native: Welcome back! How was the trip to Sicily?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Bellissimo! Quando ho visto l'Etna al tramonto, ero felicissima.
turns.phon: behl-LEES-see-moh. KWAHN-doh oh VEES-toh LEHT-nah ahl trah-MOHN-toh, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-mah
turns.native: Wonderful! When I saw Etna at sunset, I was over the moon.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Che bello! E il cibo?
turns.phon: keh BEHL-loh. eh eel CHEE-boh
turns.native: How nice! And the food?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Era tutto buonissimo, ma secondo me troppo abbondante. Mangiavamo sempre!
turns.phon: EH-rah TOOT-toh bwoh-NEES-see-moh, mah seh-KOHN-doh meh TROHP-poh ahb-bohn-DAHN-teh. mahn-jah-VAH-moh SEHM-preh
turns.native: Everything was delicious, but in my opinion too much of it. We were always eating!
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Io sono convinto che sia il posto migliore d'Italia per mangiare.
turns.phon: EE-oh SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh SEE-ah eel POHS-toh mee-LYOH-reh dee-TAH-lyah pehr mahn-JAH-reh
turns.native: I'm convinced it's the best place in Italy for food.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: È vero, ma il traffico a Palermo è terribile. Un giorno abbiamo perso due ore.
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah eel TRAHF-fee-koh ah pah-LEHR-moh eh tehr-REE-bee-leh. oon JOR-noh ahb-BYAH-moh PEHR-soh DOO-eh OH-reh
turns.native: That's true, but the traffic in Palermo is terrible. One day we lost two hours.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Vuoi dire che non ci torneresti?
turns.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh nohn chee tor-neh-REHS-tee
turns.native: Do you mean you wouldn't go back?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Al contrario! Ma la prossima volta senza macchina.
turns.phon: ahl kohn-TRAH-ryoh. mah lah PROHS-see-mah VOHL-tah SEHN-tsah MAHK-kee-nah
turns.native: On the contrary! But next time without a car.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: A proposito, hai visto le mail del cliente?
turns.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, AH-ee VEES-toh leh MAYL dehl klee-EHN-teh
turns.native: By the way, did you see the client's emails?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Non ancora, le guardo subito. Grazie!
turns.phon: nohn ahn-KOH-rah, leh GWAR-doh SOO-bee-toh. GRAH-tsyeh
turns.native: Not yet, I'll look at them right away. Thanks!
turns.speaker: B

dialogues.situation: End of an evening with friends (tu)

turns.study: Che bella serata! Grazie per la cena.
turns.phon: keh BEHL-lah seh-RAH-tah. GRAH-tsyeh pehr lah CHEH-nah
turns.native: What a lovely evening! Thanks for dinner.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Grazie a te. Allora, cosa ne pensi del film di cui parlavamo?
turns.phon: GRAH-tsyeh ah TEH. ahl-LOH-rah, KOH-zah neh PEHN-see dehl FEELM dee KWEE par-lah-VAH-moh
turns.native: Thank you. So, what do you think of the film we were talking about?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Sinceramente, da un lato è ben fatto, dall'altro è troppo lungo.
turns.phon: seen-cheh-rah-MEHN-teh, dah oon LAH-toh eh behn FAHT-toh, dahl-LAHL-troh eh TROHP-poh LOON-goh
turns.native: Honestly, on the one hand it's well made, on the other it's too long.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: È vero, ma la storia è bellissima. Io ho pianto alla fine!
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah lah STOH-ryah eh behl-LEES-see-mah. EE-oh oh PYAHN-toh AHL-lah FEE-neh
turns.native: That's true, but the story is beautiful. I cried at the end!
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Davvero? Se ho capito bene, pensi che valga la pena vederlo al cinema.
turns.phon: dahv-VEH-roh. seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh VAHL-gah lah PEH-nah veh-DEHR-loh ahl CHEE-neh-mah
turns.native: Really? If I've understood correctly, you think it's worth seeing at the cinema.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Esatto. Hai ragione sulla lunghezza, però non mi sono annoiata un minuto.
turns.phon: eh-ZAHT-toh. AH-ee rah-JOH-neh SOOL-lah loon-GEHT-tsah, peh-ROH nohn mee SOH-noh ahn-noh-YAH-tah oon mee-NOO-toh
turns.native: Exactly. You're right about the length, but I wasn't bored for a minute.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: In sintesi, non siamo d'accordo, ma va bene così!
turns.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, nohn SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh, mah vah BEH-neh koh-ZEE
turns.native: In short, we don't agree, but that's fine!
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Come sempre! A proposito, come sta tua madre?
turns.phon: KOH-meh SEHM-preh. ah proh-POH-zee-toh, KOH-meh stah TOO-ah MAH-dreh
turns.native: As always! By the way, how is your mother?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Meglio, grazie. È tornata a casa ieri. Beh, si è fatto tardi, devo andare.
turns.phon: MEH-lyoh, GRAH-tsyeh. eh tor-NAH-tah ah KAH-zah YEH-ree. beh, see eh FAHT-toh TAR-dee, DEH-voh ahn-DAH-reh
turns.native: Better, thanks. She came home yesterday. Well, it's getting late, I have to go.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Salutamela! Ci sentiamo presto, buonanotte!
turns.phon: sah-LOO-tah-meh-lah. chee sehn-TYAH-moh PREHS-toh, bwoh-nah-NOHT-teh
turns.native: Say hi to her from me! Speak soon, good night!
turns.speaker: B

turns.reading: いくらですか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.phon: ko-chi-ra wa has-se-n e-n de, a-chi-ra wa go-se-n e-n de-su

dialogues.situation: At the restaurant: a reasoned preference

turns.study: マリーさんは和食と洋食とどちらが好きですか。
turns.phon: ma-ri-i-sa-n wa wa-sho-ku to yo-o-sho-ku to do-chi-ra ga su-ki de-su ka

turns.speaker: B

turns.native: What about before?

turns.speaker: A

turns.speaker: B

turns.study: いいですね。私は料理が下手ですから、よく外で食べます。
turns.phon: i-i de-su ne. wa-ta-shi wa ryo-o-ri ga he-ta de-su ka-ra, yo-ku so-to de ta-be-ma-su
turns.native: That's good. I'm a bad cook, so I often eat out.

turns.study: 外食は高くないですか。

turns.phon: ni-ho-n wa fu-ra-n-su yo-ri ya-su-i to o-mo-i-ma-su
turns.native: I think Japan is cheaper than France.

turns.speaker: A

turns.study: そうですね。確かに安いです。
turns.phon: so-o de-su ne. ta-shi-ka ni ya-su-i de-su

turns.reading: そうですね。たしかにやすいです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 田中さん、今日は早く帰りますか。
turns.phon: ta-na-ka-sa-n, kyo-o wa ha-ya-ku ka-e-ri-ma-su ka
turns.native: Mr Tanaka, are you leaving early today?
turns.reading: たなかさん、きょうははやくかえりますか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: はい、子供を迎えに行くので、五時に帰ります。
turns.phon: ha-i, ko-do-mo o mu-ka-e ni i-ku no-de, go-ji ni ka-e-ri-ma-su
turns.native: Yes, I'm picking up my child, so I'm leaving at five.
turns.reading: はい、こどもをむかえにいくので、ごじにかえります。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: そうですか。田中さんは車で来ますか。
turns.phon: so-o de-su ka. ta-na-ka-sa-n wa ku-ru-ma de ki-ma-su ka

turns.reading: そうですか。たなかさんはくるまできますか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: いいえ、電車で来ます。電車の方が速いと思います。
turns.phon: i-i-e, de-n-sha de ki-ma-su. de-n-sha no ho-o ga ha-ya-i to o-mo-i-ma-su
turns.native: No, I come by train. I think the train is faster.
turns.reading: いいえ、でんしゃできます。でんしゃのほうがはやいとおもいます。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 私は自転車です。安いし、健康にいいからです。
turns.phon: wa-ta-shi wa ji-te-n-sha de-su. ya-su-i shi, ke-n-ko-o ni i-i ka-ra de-su
turns.native: I come by bike. Because it's cheap and good for your health.
turns.reading: わたしはじてんしゃです。やすいし、けんこうにいいからです。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: いいですね。前は私も自転車に乗っていましたが、今は遠いので電車です。
turns.phon: i-i de-su ne. ma-e wa wa-ta-shi mo ji-te-n-sha ni not-te i-ma-shi-ta ga, i-ma wa to-o-i no-de de-n-sha de-su
turns.native: That's nice. I used to ride a bike too, but now it's far, so I take the train.
turns.reading: いいですね。まえはわたしもじてんしゃにのっていましたが、いまはとおいのででんしゃです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 引っ越しましたか。
turns.phon: hik-ko-shi-ma-shi-ta ka
turns.native: Did you move?
turns.reading: ひっこしましたか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: はい、去年、郊外に引っ越しました。静かで、家が広いです。
turns.phon: ha-i, kyo-ne-n, ko-o-ga-i ni hik-ko-shi-ma-shi-ta. shi-zu-ka de, i-e ga hi-ro-i de-su

units.frame: 私は{s}べきだと思います。

firstVariant.study: 私はもっと休むべきだと思います。
firstVariant.phon: wa-ta-shi wa mot-to ya-su-mu be-ki da to o-mo-i-ma-su
firstVariant.native: I think we should rest more.
firstVariant.reading: わたしはもっとやすむべきだとおもいます。

lastVariant.study: 私は計画を変えるべきだと思います。
lastVariant.phon: wa-ta-shi wa ke-i-ka-ku o ka-e-ru be-ki da to o-mo-i-ma-su
lastVariant.native: I think we should change the plan.
lastVariant.reading: わたしはけいかくをかえるべきだとおもいます。

units.frame: ところで、{s}はどうですか。

firstVariant.study: ところで、仕事はどうですか。
firstVariant.phon: to-ko-ro de, shi-go-to wa do-o de-su ka
firstVariant.native: By the way, how is work?
firstVariant.reading: ところで、しごとはどうですか。

lastVariant.study: ところで、日本語の勉強はどうですか。
lastVariant.phon: to-ko-ro de, ni-ho-n-go no be-n-kyo-o wa do-o de-su ka
lastVariant.native: By the way, how are your Japanese studies going?
lastVariant.reading: ところで、にほんごのべんきょうはどうですか。

units.situation: Understanding the other person while objecting
units.frame: {s}のは分かりますが、難しいと思います。

firstVariant.study: 言いたいのは分かりますが、難しいと思います。
firstVariant.phon: i-i-ta-i no wa wa-ka-ri-ma-su ga, mu-zu-ka-shi-i to o-mo-i-ma-su
firstVariant.native: I understand what you mean, but I think it's difficult.
firstVariant.reading: いいたいのはわかりますが、むずかしいとおもいます。

lastVariant.study: 安くしたいのは分かりますが、難しいと思います。
lastVariant.phon: ya-su-ku shi-ta-i no wa wa-ka-ri-ma-su ga, mu-zu-ka-shi-i to o-mo-i-ma-su
lastVariant.native: I understand that you want a lower price, but I think it's difficult.
lastVariant.reading: やすくしたいのはわかりますが、むずかしいとおもいます。

firstVariant.study: それに、時間もかかります。
firstVariant.reading: それに、じかんもかかります。

lastVariant.study: それに、皆疲れています。
lastVariant.native: Besides, everyone is tired.
lastVariant.reading: それに、みんなつかれています。

firstVariant.study: 結局、家を買うことにしました。
firstVariant.phon: kek-kyo-ku, i-e o ka-u ko-to ni shi-ma-shi-ta
firstVariant.native: In the end, we decided to buy the house.
firstVariant.reading: けっきょく、いえをかうことにしました。

lastVariant.study: 結局、来年結婚することにしました。
lastVariant.phon: kek-kyo-ku, ra-i-ne-n kek-ko-n su-ru ko-to ni shi-ma-shi-ta
lastVariant.native: In the end, we decided to get married next year.
lastVariant.reading: けっきょく、らいねんけっこんすることにしました。

turns.study: マリーさんは、都会と田舎とどちらに住みたいですか。
turns.phon: ma-ri-i-sa-n wa, to-ka-i to i-na-ka to do-chi-ra ni su-mi-ta-i de-su ka
turns.native: Marie, would you rather live in the city or in the countryside?
turns.reading: まりーさんは、とかいといなかとどちらにすみたいですか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: どちらかと言うと田舎です。一方で静かで家が広いですが、他方で仕事が少ないです。
turns.phon: do-chi-ra ka to i-u to i-na-ka de-su. ip-po-o de shi-zu-ka de i-e ga hi-ro-i de-su ga, ta-ho-o de shi-go-to ga su-ku-na-i de-su
turns.native: If anything, the countryside. On the one hand it's quiet and the houses are big, but on the other there are few jobs.
turns.reading: どちらかというといなかです。いっぽうでしずかでいえがひろいですが、たほうでしごとがすくないです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 確かにそうですが、今はリモートワークもありますよ。
turns.phon: ta-shi-ka ni so-o de-su ga, i-ma wa ri-mo-o-to-wa-a-ku mo a-ri-ma-su yo
turns.native: That's true, but these days there's remote work too.
turns.reading: たしかにそうですが、いまはりもーとわーくもありますよ。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: そうですね。でも、子供の学校が心配です。
turns.phon: so-o de-su ne. de-mo, ko-do-mo no gak-ko-o ga shi-n-pa-i de-su
turns.native: Yes. But I worry about the children's school.
turns.reading: そうですね。でも、こどものがっこうがしんぱいです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: つまり、教育が一番大切だとお考えなんですね。
turns.phon: tsu-ma-ri, kyo-o-i-ku ga i-chi-ba-n ta-i-se-tsu da to o-ka-n-ga-e na-n de-su ne
turns.native: So if I understand you, you think education is the most important thing.
turns.reading: つまり、きょういくがいちばんたいせつだとおかんがえなんですね。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: はい。それに、病院も遠いです。
turns.phon: ha-i. so-re ni, byo-o-i-n mo to-o-i de-su
turns.native: Yes. Besides, the hospital is far away too.
turns.reading: はい。それに、びょういんもとおいです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 私は前は都会に住んでいましたが、今は郊外です。両方のいいところがあります。
turns.phon: wa-ta-shi wa ma-e wa to-ka-i ni su-n-de i-ma-shi-ta ga, i-ma wa ko-o-ga-i de-su. ryo-o-ho-o no i-i to-ko-ro ga a-ri-ma-su
turns.native: I used to live in the city, but now I'm in the suburbs. You get the best of both.
turns.reading: わたしはまえはとかいにすんでいましたが、いまはこうがいです。りょうほうのいいところがあります。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: いいですね。まとめると、郊外が一番いいかもしれませんね。
turns.phon: i-i de-su ne. ma-to-me-ru to, ko-o-ga-i ga i-chi-ba-n i-i ka-mo shi-re-ma-se-n ne
turns.native: That's nice. To sum up, the suburbs might be the best option.
turns.reading: いいですね。まとめると、こうがいがいちばんいいかもしれませんね。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: そう思います。ところで、ご家族はお元気ですか。
turns.phon: so-o o-mo-i-ma-su. to-ko-ro de, go-ka-zo-ku wa o-ge-n-ki de-su ka
turns.native: I think so too. By the way, how is your family?
turns.reading: そうおもいます。ところで、ごかぞくはおげんきですか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: はい、おかげさまで。
turns.phon: ha-i, o-ka-ge-sa-ma de
turns.native: Fine, thank you.
turns.reading: はい、おかげさまで。
turns.speaker: B

dialogues.situation: Telling about a trip, then taking leave

turns.study: ポールさん、お久しぶりです。沖縄はどうでしたか。
turns.phon: po-o-ru-sa-n, o-hi-sa-shi-bu-ri de-su. o-ki-na-wa wa do-o de-shi-ta ka
turns.native: Paul, it's been a while! How was Okinawa?
turns.reading: ぽーるさん、おひさしぶりです。おきなわはどうでしたか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 最高でした。海がとてもきれいで、着いたとき、本当に嬉しかったです。
turns.phon: sa-i-ko-o de-shi-ta. u-mi ga to-te-mo ki-re-i de, tsu-i-ta to-ki, ho-n-to-o ni u-re-shi-kat-ta de-su
turns.native: It was wonderful. The sea was beautiful, and when I arrived, I was really happy.
turns.reading: さいこうでした。うみがとてもきれいで、ついたとき、ほんとうにうれしかったです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 本当ですか。何日間行きましたか。
turns.phon: ho-n-to-o de-su ka. na-n-ni-chi-ka-n i-ki-ma-shi-ta ka
turns.native: Really? How many days did you go for?
turns.reading: ほんとうですか。なんにちかんいきましたか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 一週間です。まず那覇を見て、それから島に行きました。でも、台風が来たとき、とても心配しました。
turns.phon: is-shu-u-ka-n de-su. ma-zu na-ha o mi-te, so-re-ka-ra shi-ma ni i-ki-ma-shi-ta. de-mo, ta-i-fu-u ga ki-ta to-ki, to-te-mo shi-n-pa-i shi-ma-shi-ta
turns.native: One week. First I saw Naha, then I went to the islands. But when the typhoon came, I was very worried.
turns.reading: いっしゅうかんです。まずなはをみて、それからしまにいきました。でも、たいふうがきたとき、とてもしんぱいしました。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 大変でしたね。それで、どうしましたか。
turns.phon: ta-i-he-n de-shi-ta ne. so-re de, do-o shi-ma-shi-ta ka
turns.native: That must have been hard. So what did you do?
turns.reading: たいへんでしたね。それで、どうしましたか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 二日ホテルにいました。その後は天気が良くなりました。
turns.phon: fu-tsu-ka ho-te-ru ni i-ma-shi-ta. so-no a-to wa te-n-ki ga yo-ku na-ri-ma-shi-ta
turns.native: I stayed in the hotel for two days. After that, the weather got better.
turns.reading: ふつかほてるにいました。そのあとはてんきがよくなりました。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 良かったですね。私も来年行きたいです。
turns.phon: yo-kat-ta de-su ne. wa-ta-shi mo ra-i-ne-n i-ki-ta-i de-su
turns.native: I'm glad. I'd like to go next year too.
turns.reading: よかったですね。わたしもらいねんいきたいです。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: ぜひ。夏より秋の方がいいと思いますよ。台風が少ないからです。
turns.phon: ze-hi. na-tsu yo-ri a-ki no ho-o ga i-i to o-mo-i-ma-su yo. ta-i-fu-u ga su-ku-na-i ka-ra de-su
turns.native: Do! I think autumn is better than summer. Because there are fewer typhoons.
turns.reading: ぜひ。なつよりあきのほうがいいとおもいますよ。たいふうがすくないからです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 分かりました。では、そろそろ失礼します。また近いうちに！
turns.phon: wa-ka-ri-ma-shi-ta. de wa, so-ro-so-ro shi-tsu-re-i shi-ma-su. ma-ta chi-ka-i u-chi ni
turns.native: All right. Well, it's about time I went. See you soon!
turns.reading: わかりました。では、そろそろしつれいします。またちかいうちに！
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: はい、また。良い週末を！
turns.phon: ha-i, ma-ta. yo-i shu-u-ma-tsu o
turns.native: Yes, see you. Have a good weekend!
turns.reading: はい、また。よいしゅうまつを！
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 皆さん、今日の会議は新しい計画についてです。田中さんはどう思いますか。
turns.phon: mi-na-sa-n, kyo-o no ka-i-gi wa a-ta-ra-shi-i ke-i-ka-ku ni tsu-i-te de-su. ta-na-ka-sa-n wa do-o o-mo-i-ma-su ka
turns.native: Everyone, today's meeting is about the new project. Mr Tanaka, what do you think?
turns.reading: みなさん、きょうのかいぎはあたらしいけいかくについてです。たなかさんはどうおもいますか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 私は早く始めるべきだと思います。時間が足りないからです。
turns.phon: wa-ta-shi wa ha-ya-ku ha-ji-me-ru be-ki da to o-mo-i-ma-su. ji-ka-n ga ta-ri-na-i ka-ra de-su
turns.native: I think we should start quickly. Because there isn't enough time.
turns.reading: わたしははやくはじめるべきだとおもいます。じかんがたりないからです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 確かにそうですが、予算の問題があります。
turns.phon: ta-shi-ka ni so-o de-su ga, yo-sa-n no mo-n-da-i ga a-ri-ma-su
turns.native: That's true, but there's a budget problem.
turns.reading: たしかにそうですが、よさんのもんだいがあります。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: つまり、お金が足りないとお考えなんですね。
turns.phon: tsu-ma-ri, o-ka-ne ga ta-ri-na-i to o-ka-n-ga-e na-n de-su ne
turns.native: So if I understand you, you think there isn't enough money.
turns.reading: つまり、おかねがたりないとおかんがえなんですね。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: はい。私が言いたいのは、まず小さく始めて、それから大きくするということです。
turns.phon: ha-i. wa-ta-shi ga i-i-ta-i no wa, ma-zu chi-i-sa-ku ha-ji-me-te, so-re-ka-ra o-o-ki-ku su-ru to i-u ko-to de-su
turns.native: Yes. What I mean is that we should start small, then scale up.
turns.reading: はい。わたしがいいたいのは、まずちいさくはじめて、それからおおきくするということです。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 心配なのは分かりますが、小さく始めると、時間がもっとかかると思います。
turns.phon: shi-n-pa-i na no wa wa-ka-ri-ma-su ga, chi-i-sa-ku ha-ji-me-ru to, ji-ka-n ga mot-to ka-ka-ru to o-mo-i-ma-su
turns.native: I understand your concern, but if we start small, I think it will take more time.
turns.reading: しんぱいなのはわかりますが、ちいさくはじめると、じかんがもっとかかるとおもいます。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 一部は賛成です。では、来月から始めて、三か月後にもう一度話しませんか。
turns.phon: i-chi-bu wa sa-n-se-i de-su. de wa, ra-i-ge-tsu ka-ra ha-ji-me-te, sa-n-ka-ge-tsu-go ni mo-o i-chi-do ha-na-shi-ma-se-n ka
turns.native: I partly agree. So, shall we start next month and talk again in three months?
turns.reading: いちぶはさんせいです。では、らいげつからはじめて、さんかげつごにもういちどはなしませんか。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: いいですね。それなら大丈夫です。
turns.phon: i-i de-su ne. so-re na-ra da-i-jo-o-bu de-su
turns.native: Sounds good. In that case, that's fine with me.
turns.reading: いいですね。それならだいじょうぶです。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: まとめると、計画は来月から始めて、三か月後に見直します。
turns.phon: ma-to-me-ru to, ke-i-ka-ku wa ra-i-ge-tsu ka-ra ha-ji-me-te, sa-n-ka-ge-tsu-go ni mi-na-o-shi-ma-su
turns.native: To sum up, the project starts next month and we'll review it in three months.
turns.reading: まとめると、けいかくはらいげつからはじめて、さんかげつごにみなおします。
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: はい、ありがとうございます。
turns.phon: ha-i, a-ri-ga-to-o go-za-i-ma-su
turns.native: Yes, thank you very much.
turns.reading: はい、ありがとうございます。
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 请问，火车站在哪里？

turns.phon: shyeh-shyeh. woh shyu-yow ee jahng chyu shahng-heye duh pyow.

turns.study: 给您。非常感谢。

turns.study: 一路顺风！

turns.study: 你好，我叫玛丽。

turns.reading: nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Mǎlì.

turns.study: 很高兴认识你，我是保罗。

turns.reading: hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ, wǒ shì Bǎoluó.

turns.study: 我是法国人，巴黎人。你呢？

turns.study: 我是本地人。你来度假吗？

turns.reading: wǒ shì běndì rén. nǐ lái dùjià ma?

turns.study: 是的，我很喜欢这个城市。
turns.phon: shr duh, woh hun shee-hwahn juh-guh chung-shr.
turns.native: Yes, I really like this city.

turns.phon: roo-gwoh woh may lee-jyeh tswoh, woh kuh-ee yoong juh jahng pyow dzwoh shyah ee bahn?
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I can take the next one with this ticket?
turns.reading: rúguǒ wǒ méi lǐjiě cuò, wǒ kěyǐ yòng zhè zhāng piào zuò xià yì bān?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 对，不用换票。
turns.phon: dway, boo-yoong hwahn pyow.
turns.native: Yes, no need to change your ticket.
turns.reading: duì, búyòng huàn piào.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 好。还有个问题：我的行李在哪里取？
turns.phon: how. heye yoh guh wun-tee: woh duh shing-lee dzeye nah-lee chyu?
turns.native: Okay. One more question: where do I collect my luggage?
turns.reading: hǎo. hái yǒu ge wèntí: wǒ de xíngli zài nǎlǐ qǔ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 在二号窗口，不过我不太确定现在开不开。
turns.phon: dzeye ar how chwahng-koh, boo-gwoh woh boo teye chyweh-ding shyen-dzeye keye boo keye.
turns.native: At window two, but I'm not quite sure whether it's open right now.
turns.reading: zài èr hào chuāngkǒu, búguò wǒ bú tài quèdìng xiànzài kāi bu kāi.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 那我先去问问吧。谢谢！
turns.phon: nah woh shyen chyu wun-wun bah. shyeh-shyeh!
turns.native: Then I'll go and ask first. Thanks!
turns.reading: nà wǒ xiān qù wènwen ba. xièxie!
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 您好，哪里不舒服？
turns.phon: neen how, nah-lee boo shoo-foo?
turns.native: Hello, what seems to be the problem?
turns.reading: nín hǎo, nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 我头疼，昨天晚上发烧了。
turns.phon: woh toh-tung, dzwoh-tyen wahn-shahng fah-show luh.
turns.native: I have a headache, and last night I had a fever.
turns.reading: wǒ tóuténg, zuótiān wǎnshang fāshāo le.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 咳嗽吗？
turns.phon: kuh-soh mah?
turns.native: Any cough?
turns.reading: késou ma?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 有一点，不太厉害。
turns.phon: yoh ee-dyen, boo teye lee-heye.
turns.native: A little, not too bad.
turns.reading: yǒu yìdiǎn, bú tài lìhai.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 可能是感冒。我给您开点药。
turns.phon: kun-ung shr gahn-mow. woh gay neen keye dyen yow.
turns.native: It's probably a cold. I'll prescribe you some medicine.
turns.reading: kěnéng shì gǎnmào. wǒ gěi nín kāi diǎn yào.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 如果我没理解错，这个药一天吃两次？
turns.phon: roo-gwoh woh may lee-jyeh tswoh, juh-guh yow ee tyen chr lyahng tsuh?
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, this medicine is taken twice a day?
turns.reading: rúguǒ wǒ méi lǐjiě cuò, zhège yào yì tiān chī liǎng cì?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 对，饭后吃。多喝水，多休息。
turns.phon: dway, fahn hoh chr. dwoh huh shway, dwoh shyoh-shee.
turns.native: Yes, after meals. Drink plenty of water and get plenty of rest.
turns.reading: duì, fàn hòu chī. duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 我明天可以上班吗？
turns.phon: woh ming-tyen kuh-ee shahng-bahn mah?
turns.native: Can I go to work tomorrow?
turns.reading: wǒ míngtiān kěyǐ shàngbān ma?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 我觉得比较难。最好休息两天。
turns.phon: woh jyweh-duh bee-jyow nahn. dzway-how shyoh-shee lyahng tyen.
turns.native: I think that would be rather difficult. Best to rest for two days.
turns.reading: wǒ juéde bǐjiào nán. zuìhǎo xiūxi liǎng tiān.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 好的，谢谢医生。
turns.phon: how duh, shyeh-shyeh ee-shung.
turns.native: Okay, thank you, doctor.
turns.reading: hǎo de, xièxie yīshēng.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 玛丽，报告今天要交，你做完了吗？
turns.phon: mah-lee, bow-gow jeen-tyen yow jyow, nee dzwoh wahn luh mah?
turns.native: Mary, the report is due today, have you finished it?
turns.reading: Mǎlì, bàogào jīntiān yào jiāo, nǐ zuò wán le ma?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 今天？如果我没理解错，是星期五交？
turns.phon: jeen-tyen? roo-gwoh woh may lee-jyeh tswoh, shr shing-chee-oo jyow?
turns.native: Today? If I've understood correctly, it was due Friday?
turns.reading: jīntiān? rúguǒ wǒ méi lǐjiě cuò, shì xīngqīwǔ jiāo?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 不是，客户把时间改了。
turns.phon: boo shr, kuh-hoo bah shr-jyen geye luh.
turns.native: No, the client changed the date.
turns.reading: bú shì, kèhù bǎ shíjiān gǎi le.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 可能是我没收到邮件。现在做完了一部分。
turns.phon: kun-ung shr woh may shoh-dow yoh-jyen. shyen-dzeye dzwoh wahn luh ee boo-fun.
turns.native: Maybe I didn't get the email. Part of it is done now.
turns.reading: kěnéng shì wǒ méi shōudào yóujiàn. xiànzài zuò wán le yí bùfen.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 我的意思是，今天下午五点前一定要交。
turns.phon: woh duh ee-suh shr, jeen-tyen shyah-oo oo dyen chyen ee-ding yow jyow.
turns.native: What I mean is, it absolutely has to be in before five p.m. today.
turns.reading: wǒ de yìsi shì, jīntiān xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn qián yídìng yào jiāo.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 我不太确定来不来得及。有个问题：数据还不全。怎么办？
turns.phon: woh boo teye chyweh-ding leye boo leye-duh-jee. yoh guh wun-tee: shoo-jyu heye boo chywen. dzun-muh bahn?
turns.native: I'm not sure I'll make it. There's a problem: the data isn't complete. What should we do?
turns.reading: wǒ bú tài quèdìng lái bu láidejí. yǒu ge wèntí: shùjù hái bù quán. zěnme bàn?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 那我们先交一部分吧，剩下的明天补。
turns.phon: nah woh-mun shyen jyow ee boo-fun bah, shung-shyah duh ming-tyen boo.
turns.native: Then let's hand in part of it first, and fill in the rest tomorrow.
turns.reading: nà wǒmen xiān jiāo yí bùfen ba, shèngxià de míngtiān bǔ.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: 好，我马上做。
turns.phon: how, woh mah-shahng dzwoh.
turns.native: Okay, I'll get on it right away.
turns.reading: hǎo, wǒ mǎshàng zuò.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: 对。一方面现在的公司很稳定，另一方面工资太低了。

files.reviewStatus: Rédigé à la main ; relecture par un anglophone conseillée.

longestVariant.study: In the morning, I have breakfast with my kids.
longestVariant.phon: inn ze MOR-ning, aï HAV BRÈK-feust ouiz maï KIDZ
longestVariant.native: Le matin, je prends le petit-déjeuner avec mes enfants.

longestTurn.study: Sometimes. I call him every Sunday. And you, do you have brothers or sisters?
longestTurn.phon: SEUM-taïmz. aï KOL him ÈV-ri SEUNN-dé. and YOU, dou you HAV BREU-zeurz or SIS-teurz
longestTurn.native: Parfois. Je l'appelle tous les dimanches. Et toi, tu as des frères et sœurs ?

firstVariant.study: I usually get up at seven.
firstVariant.phon: aï YOU-jou-eu-li GÈT EUP at SÈ-veun
firstVariant.native: D'habitude, je me lève à sept heures.

lastVariant.native: D'habitude, je prends le bus.

firstVariant.study: In the morning, I have breakfast with my kids.
firstVariant.phon: inn ze MOR-ning, aï HAV BRÈK-feust ouiz maï KIDZ
firstVariant.native: Le matin, je prends le petit-déjeuner avec mes enfants.

lastVariant.study: In the morning, I drink a big coffee.
lastVariant.phon: inn ze MOR-ning, aï DRINK eu BIG KO-fi
lastVariant.native: Le matin, je bois un grand café.

firstVariant.study: In the evening, I watch TV.
firstVariant.phon: inn zi IV-ning, aï OUOTCH ti-VI
firstVariant.native: Le soir, je regarde la télé.

lastVariant.study: In the evening, I go to bed early.
lastVariant.phon: inn zi IV-ning, aï GÔ tou BÈD EUR-li
lastVariant.native: Le soir, je me couche tôt.

firstVariant.study: I have a brother and a sister.
firstVariant.phon: aï HAV eu BREU-zeur and eu SIS-teur
firstVariant.native: J'ai un frère et une sœur.

lastVariant.native: J'ai un chien.
J'habite près du centre.

lastVariant.study: I work for a small company.
lastVariant.phon: aï WEURK for eu SMOL KEUM-peu-ni
lastVariant.native: Je travaille pour une petite entreprise.
J'étudie la médecine.

firstVariant.study: I go to the gym every day.
firstVariant.phon: aï GÔ tou ze DJIM ÈV-ri DÉÏ
firstVariant.native: Je vais à la salle de sport tous les jours.

lastVariant.study: I go to the gym at the weekend.
lastVariant.phon: aï GÔ tou ze DJIM at ze ouik-ÈND
lastVariant.native: Je vais à la salle de sport le week-end.
Parfois, je rends visite à ma grand-mère.

lastVariant.study: My neighbourhood is full of shops.
lastVariant.phon: maï NÉÏ-beu-houd iz foul ov CHOPS
lastVariant.native: Mon quartier est plein de magasins.

firstVariant.study: My wife works in a hospital.
firstVariant.phon: maï OUAÏF WEURKS inn eu HOS-pi-teul
firstVariant.native: Ma femme travaille dans un hôpital.

lastVariant.study: My son works in a hospital.
lastVariant.phon: maï SEUNN WEURKS inn eu HOS-pi-teul
lastVariant.native: Mon fils travaille dans un hôpital.

firstVariant.study: At the weekend, I play football.
firstVariant.phon: at ze ouik-ÈND, aï PLÉÏ FOUT-bol
firstVariant.native: Le week-end, je joue au foot.

lastVariant.study: At the weekend, I relax at home.
lastVariant.phon: at ze ouik-ÈND, aï ri-LAKS at HÔM
lastVariant.native: Le week-end, je me repose à la maison.

lastVariant.study: My flat has a view of the sea.
lastVariant.phon: maï FLAT haz eu VYOU ov ze SI
lastVariant.native: Mon appartement a une vue sur la mer.

turns.study: What do you do, Ana?
turns.phon: ouot dou you DOU, A-na
turns.native: Qu'est-ce que tu fais dans la vie, Ana ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: I work in a bank. And you?
turns.phon: aï WEURK inn eu BANK. and YOU
turns.native: Je travaille dans une banque. Et toi ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: I'm a teacher. I work in a school near here.
turns.phon: aïm eu TI-tcheur. aï WEURK inn eu SKOUL NIR HIR
turns.native: Je suis prof. Je travaille dans une école près d'ici.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Do you live in the centre?
turns.phon: dou you LIV inn ze SÈN-teur
turns.native: Tu habites dans le centre ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: No, I live in a flat near the sea, with my family.
turns.phon: NÔ, aï LIV inn eu FLAT NIR ze SI, ouiz maï FA-mi-li
turns.native: Non, j'habite dans un appartement près de la mer, avec ma famille.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Nice! Do you have children?
turns.phon: NAÏSS. dou you HAV TCHIL-dreun
turns.native: Super ! Tu as des enfants ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Yes, two kids. In the morning, I take them to school.
turns.phon: YÈS, TOU KIDZ. inn ze MOR-ning, aï TÉÏK zèm tou SKOUL
turns.native: Oui, deux enfants. Le matin, je les emmène à l'école.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: And in the evening?
turns.phon: and inn zi IV-ning
turns.native: Et le soir ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: I usually cook, then I read a bit.
turns.phon: aï YOU-jou-eu-li KOUK, zèn aï RID eu BIT
turns.native: D'habitude je cuisine, puis je lis un peu.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Welcome! This is my flat.
turns.phon: OUÈL-keum. ZISS iz maï FLAT
turns.native: Bienvenue ! C'est mon appartement.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: It's lovely. Is it big?
turns.phon: its LEUV-li. iz it BIG
turns.native: Il est très joli. Il est grand ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Not really. It has two bedrooms and a small balcony.
turns.phon: not RI-li. it haz TOU BÈD-roumz and eu SMOL BAL-keu-ni
turns.native: Pas vraiment. Il a deux chambres et un petit balcon.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: And the neighbourhood?
turns.phon: and ze NÉÏ-beu-houd
turns.native: Et le quartier ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: It's quiet, but there's a market every Saturday.
turns.phon: its KOUAÏ-eut, beut zèrz eu MAR-kit ÈV-ri SA-teur-dé
turns.native: Il est calme, mais il y a un marché tous les samedis.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Do you often go?
turns.phon: dou you O-feun GÔ
turns.native: Tu y vas souvent ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Every week. I like cooking at the weekend.
turns.phon: ÈV-ri OUIK. aï LAÏK KOU-king at ze ouik-ÈND
turns.native: Toutes les semaines. J'aime cuisiner le week-end.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Me too! Shall we cook together on Saturday?
turns.phon: mi TOU. chal oui KOUK tou-GUÈ-zeur onn SA-teur-dé
turns.native: Moi aussi ! On cuisine ensemble samedi ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Yes, sure!
turns.phon: YÈS, CHOUR
turns.native: Oui, d'accord !
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Do you have a big family, Paul?
turns.phon: dou you HAV eu BIG FA-mi-li, POL
turns.native: Tu as une grande famille, Paul ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Yes. I have a brother and two sisters.
turns.phon: YÈS. aï HAV eu BREU-zeur and TOU SIS-teurz
turns.native: Oui. J'ai un frère et deux sœurs.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Do they live here?
turns.phon: dou zéï LIV HIR
turns.native: Ils habitent ici ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: My brother lives in London. My sisters live in Leeds, with my parents.
turns.phon: maï BREU-zeur LIVZ inn LEUN-deun. maï SIS-teurz LIV inn LIDZ, ouiz maï PÈ-reunts
turns.native: Mon frère habite à Londres. Mes sœurs habitent à Leeds, avec mes parents.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: What does your brother do?
turns.phon: ouot deuz yor BREU-zeur DOU
turns.native: Que fait ton frère ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: He's a doctor. He works in a hospital.
turns.phon: hiz eu DOK-teur. hi WEURKS inn eu HOS-pi-teul
turns.native: Il est médecin. Il travaille dans un hôpital.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Do you see him often?
turns.phon: dou you SI him O-feun
turns.native: Tu le vois souvent ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Sometimes. I call him every Sunday. And you, do you have brothers or sisters?
turns.phon: SEUM-taïmz. aï KOL him ÈV-ri SEUNN-dé. and YOU, dou you HAV BREU-zeurz or SIS-teurz
turns.native: Parfois. Je l'appelle tous les dimanches. Et toi, tu as des frères et sœurs ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: No, I'm an only child.
turns.phon: NÔ, aïm eun ÔN-li TCHAÏLD
turns.native: Non, je suis enfant unique.
turns.speaker: A

files.reviewStatus: Rédigé à la main ; relecture par un anglophone conseillée.

longestVariant.study: First I walked by the river, then I went home.
longestVariant.phon: FEURST aï OUOKT baï ze RI-veur, zèn aï OUÈNT HÔM
longestVariant.native: D'abord j'ai marché le long de la rivière, puis je suis rentré(e).

longestTurn.study: Really busy. On Saturday, first I did the shopping, then I took the kids to football.
longestTurn.phon: RI-li BI-zi. onn SA-teur-dé, FEURST aï did ze CHO-ping, zèn aï TOUK ze KIDZ tou FOUT-bol
longestTurn.native: Très chargé. Samedi, d'abord j'ai fait les courses, puis j'ai emmené les enfants au foot.

firstVariant.native: Hier, j'ai travaillé toute la journée.

lastVariant.native: Hier, j'ai rendu visite à mes parents.
Je suis allé(e) à la plage.

firstVariant.native: Nous sommes arrivés la semaine dernière.

lastVariant.native: Nous sommes arrivés le mois dernier.
Ça fait longtemps !
C'est une bonne nouvelle !

units.frame: First I {s}, then I went home.

firstVariant.study: First I had a coffee, then I went home.
firstVariant.phon: FEURST aï had eu KO-fi, zèn aï OUÈNT HÔM
firstVariant.native: D'abord j'ai pris un café, puis je suis rentré(e).

lastVariant.study: First I walked by the river, then I went home.
lastVariant.phon: FEURST aï OUOKT baï ze RI-veur, zèn aï OUÈNT HÔM
lastVariant.native: D'abord j'ai marché le long de la rivière, puis je suis rentré(e).

lastVariant.study: After that, we talked for hours.
lastVariant.phon: AF-teur ZAT, oui TOKT for AÔ-eurz
lastVariant.native: Après, on a parlé pendant des heures.
Le week-end dernier était très chargé.

firstVariant.study: Did you have a good weekend?
firstVariant.phon: did you HAV eu goud ouik-ÈND
firstVariant.native: Tu as passé un bon week-end ?

lastVariant.native: Tu as aimé le film ?

firstVariant.native: Où est-ce que tu es allé(e) ?

lastVariant.native: Où est-ce que tu as acheté ça ?

firstVariant.native: En vacances, on a visité Rome.

lastVariant.study: On holiday, we rented a car.
lastVariant.phon: onn HO-li-dé, oui RÈN-tid eu KAR
lastVariant.native: En vacances, on a loué une voiture.

firstVariant.study: This morning I had a meeting.
firstVariant.phon: ZISS MOR-ning aï had eu MI-ting
firstVariant.native: Ce matin, j'ai eu une réunion.

lastVariant.study: This morning I called the client.
lastVariant.phon: ZISS MOR-ning aï KOLD ze KLAÏ-eunt
lastVariant.native: Ce matin, j'ai appelé le client.

units.situation: Ce que je n'ai pas fait

lastVariant.native: Je n'ai pas compris.

turns.study: Hi Paul! Long time no see!
turns.phon: HAÏ POL. LONG TAÏM nô SI
turns.native: Salut Paul ! Ça fait longtemps !
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Hi Mary! How are you? What's new?
turns.phon: HAÏ MÈ-ri. HAÔ ar you. ouots NYOU
turns.native: Salut Marie ! Ça va ? Quoi de neuf ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Fine, thanks. I went to Rome last week.
turns.phon: FAÏN, THANKS. aï OUÈNT tou RÔM LAST OUIK
turns.native: Ça va, merci. Je suis allée à Rome la semaine dernière.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Really? For work?
turns.phon: RI-li. for WEURK
turns.native: Vraiment ? Pour le travail ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: No, on holiday, with my sister. We visited everything and ate very well.
turns.phon: NÔ, onn HO-li-dé, ouiz maï SIS-teur. oui VI-zi-tid ÈV-ri-thing and ÉÏT VÈ-ri OUÈL
turns.native: Non, en vacances, avec ma sœur. On a tout visité et très bien mangé.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: That's great! I didn't go anywhere.
turns.phon: zats GRÉÏT. aï DI-deunt GÔ È-ni-ouèr
turns.native: C'est super ! Moi, je ne suis allé nulle part.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: What a pity! What did you do?
turns.phon: ouot eu PI-ti. ouot did you DOU
turns.native: Dommage ! Qu'est-ce que tu as fait ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: I worked all day, every day. But yesterday I saw a good film.
turns.phon: aï WEURKT OL DÉÏ, ÈV-ri DÉÏ. beut YÈS-teur-dé aï SO eu goud FILM
turns.native: J'ai travaillé toute la journée, tous les jours. Mais hier j'ai vu un bon film.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Good morning, Ana. Did you have a good weekend?
turns.phon: goud MOR-ning, A-na. did you HAV eu goud ouik-ÈND
turns.native: Bonjour, Ana. Tu as passé un bon week-end ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Yes, very quiet. I stayed at home and read. And you?
turns.phon: YÈS, VÈ-ri KOUAÏ-eut. aï STÉÏD at HÔM and RÈD. and YOU
turns.native: Oui, très calme. Je suis restée à la maison et j'ai lu. Et toi ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Really busy. On Saturday, first I did the shopping, then I took the kids to football.
turns.phon: RI-li BI-zi. onn SA-teur-dé, FEURST aï did ze CHO-ping, zèn aï TOUK ze KIDZ tou FOUT-bol
turns.native: Très chargé. Samedi, d'abord j'ai fait les courses, puis j'ai emmené les enfants au foot.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Did they win?
turns.phon: did zéï OUINN
turns.native: Ils ont gagné ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: No, they lost two-one.
turns.phon: NÔ, zéï LOST TOU OUANN
turns.native: Non, ils ont perdu deux à un.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Oh, what a pity! And on Sunday?
turns.phon: Ô, ouot eu PI-ti. and onn SEUNN-dé
turns.native: Oh, dommage ! Et dimanche ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: After that, we went to my parents' for lunch. I didn't sleep much!
turns.phon: AF-teur ZAT, oui OUÈNT tou maï PÈ-reunts for LEUNTCH. aï DI-deunt SLIP MEUTCH
turns.native: Après, on est allés déjeuner chez mes parents. Je n'ai pas beaucoup dormi !
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: I see. Shall we have a coffee before the meeting?
turns.phon: aï SI. chal oui HAV eu KO-fi bi-FOR ze MI-ting
turns.native: Je vois. On prend un café avant la réunion ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Yes, sure.
turns.phon: YÈS, CHOUR
turns.native: Oui, d'accord.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Hello Mum, how are you?
turns.phon: hè-LÔ MEUM, HAÔ ar you
turns.native: Allô maman, ça va ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Fine, dear. What's new?
turns.phon: FAÏN, DIR. ouots NYOU
turns.native: Ça va, ma chérie. Quoi de neuf ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: I had a meeting with the boss this morning.
turns.phon: aï had eu MI-ting ouiz ze BOSS ZISS MOR-ning
turns.native: J'ai eu une réunion avec le chef ce matin.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: And?
turns.phon: AND
turns.native: Et ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: I got the new job!
turns.phon: aï GOT ze NYOU DJOB
turns.native: J'ai eu le nouveau poste !
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: That's amazing! When do you start?
turns.phon: zats eu-MÉÏ-zing. OUÈN dou you START
turns.native: C'est incroyable ! Tu commences quand ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: In two weeks. Two days ago, I didn't know anything.
turns.phon: inn TOU OUIKS. TOU DÉÏZ eu-GÔ, aï DI-deunt NÔ È-ni-thing
turns.native: Dans deux semaines. Il y a deux jours, je ne savais rien.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: I'm so happy for you. Did you tell your father?
turns.phon: aïm sô HA-pi for you. did you TÈL yor FA-zeur
turns.native: Je suis si contente pour toi. Tu l'as dit à ton père ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Not yet. I'll call him tonight.
turns.phon: not YÈT. aïl KOL him tou-NAÏT
turns.native: Pas encore. Je l'appelle ce soir.
turns.speaker: A

longestVariant.study: We're going to take a taxi from the airport.
longestVariant.phon: ouir GÔ-ing tou TÉÏK eu TAK-si from zi ÈR-port
longestVariant.native: On va prendre un taxi depuis l'aéroport.

longestTurn.study: I can't on Saturday, I'm going to visit my parents. But Sunday is fine.
longestTurn.phon: aï KANT onn SA-teur-dé, aïm GÔ-ing tou VI-zit maï PÈ-reunts. beut SEUNN-dé iz FAÏN
longestTurn.native: Je ne peux pas samedi, je vais rendre visite à mes parents. Mais dimanche, c'est bon.

firstVariant.study: I'm going to visit my parents.
firstVariant.phon: aïm GÔ-ing tou VI-zit maï PÈ-reunts
firstVariant.native: Je vais rendre visite à mes parents.

lastVariant.study: I'm going to stay at home this weekend.
lastVariant.phon: aïm GÔ-ing tou STÉÏ at HÔM ZISS ouik-ÈND
lastVariant.native: Je vais rester à la maison ce week-end.

firstVariant.study: Do you feel like going to the cinema?
firstVariant.phon: dou you FIL laïk GÔ-ing tou ze SI-neu-ma
firstVariant.native: Ça te dit d'aller au cinéma ?

lastVariant.study: Do you feel like eating out tonight?
lastVariant.phon: dou you FIL laïk I-ting AÔT tou-NAÏT
lastVariant.native: Ça te dit de manger au restaurant ce soir ?

lastVariant.study: Let's say Friday evening at my place.
lastVariant.phon: lèts SÉÏ FRAÏ-dé IV-ning at maï PLÉÏSS
lastVariant.native: Disons vendredi soir chez moi.

firstVariant.study: I can't, but Sunday is fine.
firstVariant.phon: aï KANT, beut SEUNN-dé iz FAÏN
firstVariant.native: Je ne peux pas, mais dimanche, c'est bon.

lastVariant.study: I can't, but we can meet later.
lastVariant.phon: aï KANT, beut oui kann MIT LÉÏ-teur
lastVariant.native: Je ne peux pas, mais on peut se voir plus tard.

firstVariant.study: I'd really like to see the sea.
firstVariant.phon: aïd RI-li LAÏK tou SI ze SI

lastVariant.study: I'd really like to learn Spanish.
lastVariant.phon: aïd RI-li LAÏK tou LEURN SPA-nich
lastVariant.native: J'aimerais vraiment apprendre l'espagnol.
Désolé(e), je suis pris(e) ce jour-là.
Donc, tu réserves la table ?

firstVariant.study: We're going to take the train at nine.
firstVariant.phon: ouir GÔ-ing tou TÉÏK ze TRÉÏN at NAÏN
firstVariant.native: On va prendre le train de neuf heures.

lastVariant.study: We're going to take my car.
lastVariant.phon: ouir GÔ-ing tou TÉÏK maï KAR
lastVariant.native: On va prendre ma voiture.

firstVariant.study: Next week I have a meeting in London.
firstVariant.phon: NÈKST OUIK aï HAV eu MI-ting inn LEUN-deun
firstVariant.native: La semaine prochaine, j'ai une réunion à Londres.

lastVariant.study: Next week I have a lot of work.
lastVariant.phon: NÈKST OUIK aï HAV eu LOT ov WEURK
lastVariant.native: La semaine prochaine, j'ai beaucoup de travail.

firstVariant.study: When are you going to come?
firstVariant.phon: OUÈN ar you GÔ-ing tou KEUM
firstVariant.native: Quand est-ce que tu vas venir ?

lastVariant.study: When are you going to decide?
lastVariant.phon: OUÈN ar you GÔ-ing tou di-SAÏD
lastVariant.native: Quand est-ce que tu vas décider ?

firstVariant.study: I'm planning to go to Scotland in June.
firstVariant.phon: aïm PLA-ning tou GÔ tou SKOT-leund inn DJOUN
firstVariant.native: J'ai l'intention d'aller en Écosse en juin.

lastVariant.study: I'm planning to start a course.
lastVariant.phon: aïm PLA-ning tou START eu KORSS
lastVariant.native: J'ai l'intention de commencer une formation.

firstVariant.study: Would you like to join us?
firstVariant.phon: would you LAÏK tou DJOÏN euss

lastVariant.study: Would you like to meet at nine instead?
lastVariant.phon: would you LAÏK tou MIT at NAÏN inn-STÈD
lastVariant.native: Voulez-vous qu'on se voie plutôt à neuf heures ?

turns.study: Hi Ana! Do you feel like going to the cinema this weekend?
turns.phon: HAÏ A-na. dou you FIL laïk GÔ-ing tou ze SI-neu-ma ZISS ouik-ÈND
turns.native: Salut Ana ! Ça te dit d'aller au cinéma ce week-end ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Good idea! When?
turns.phon: goud aï-DI-a. OUÈN
turns.native: Bonne idée ! Quand ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Saturday at eight?
turns.phon: SA-teur-dé at ÉÏT
turns.native: Samedi à huit heures ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: I can't on Saturday, I'm going to visit my parents. But Sunday is fine.
turns.phon: aï KANT onn SA-teur-dé, aïm GÔ-ing tou VI-zit maï PÈ-reunts. beut SEUNN-dé iz FAÏN
turns.native: Je ne peux pas samedi, je vais rendre visite à mes parents. Mais dimanche, c'est bon.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: OK, Sunday at six, in front of the cinema?
turns.phon: ô-KÉÏ, SEUNN-dé at SIKS, inn FREUNT ov ze SI-neu-ma
turns.native: D'accord, dimanche à six heures, devant le cinéma ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: That works for me. Shall we eat something after?
turns.phon: zat WEURKS for mi. chal oui IT SEUM-thing AF-teur
turns.native: Ça me va. On mange quelque chose après ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Yes, sure. I'll book a table.
turns.phon: YÈS, CHOUR. aïl BOUK eu TÉÏ-beul
turns.native: Oui, d'accord. Je réserve une table.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Perfect. See you on Sunday!
turns.phon: PEUR-fikt. SI you onn SEUNN-dé
turns.native: Parfait. À dimanche !
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Paul, are you free on Tuesday?
turns.phon: POL, ar you FRI onn TYOUZ-dé

turns.native: Franchement ? Tel que je vois les choses, ça vaut le coup d'essayer, mais le moment est mal choisi.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Why do you say that?
turns.phon: OUAÏ dou you SÉÏ ZAT
turns.native: Pourquoi tu dis ça ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Because half the team is on holiday in August. In other words, we'd start with three people.
turns.phon: bi-KOZ HAF ze TIM iz onn HO-li-dé inn O-gueust. inn EU-zeur WEURDZ, ouid START ouiz THRI PI-peul
turns.native: Parce que la moitié de l'équipe est en vacances en août. Autrement dit, on commencerait à trois.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: That's true, but the client won't wait until September.
turns.phon: zats TROU, beut ze KLAÏ-eunt wônt OUÉÏT eun-TIL sèp-TÈM-beur
turns.native: C'est vrai, mais le client n'attendra pas septembre.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: I agree with you about the client. Could we start small, then grow in September?
turns.phon: aï eu-GRI ouiz you eu-BAÔT ze KLAÏ-eunt. koud oui START SMOL, zèn GRÔ inn sèp-TÈM-beur
turns.native: Je suis d'accord avec toi sur le client. On pourrait commencer petit, puis grandir en septembre ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: If I get you right, you think we should do the first phase now, with a small team?
turns.phon: if aï GÈT you RAÏT, you THINK oui choud DOU ze FEURST FÉÏZ NAÔ, ouiz eu SMOL TIM
turns.native: Si je comprends bien, tu penses qu'on devrait faire la première phase maintenant, avec une petite équipe ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Exactly. And if the client agrees, I'll write the plan this week.
turns.phon: ig-ZAKT-li. and if ze KLAÏ-eunt eu-GRIZ, aïl RAÏT ze PLAN ZISS OUIK
turns.native: Exactement. Et si le client est d'accord, j'écris le plan cette semaine.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: To sum up, small start in August, full team in September. Good.
turns.phon: tou SEUM EUP, SMOL START inn O-gueust, foul TIM inn sèp-TÈM-beur. GOUD
turns.native: Pour résumer, petit démarrage en août, équipe complète en septembre. Bien.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Well, I have to go, I've got a call at four. See you tomorrow!
turns.phon: OUÈL, aï hav tou GÔ, aïv GOT eu KOL at FOR. SI you tou-MO-rô
turns.native: Bon, je dois y aller, j'ai un appel à seize heures. À demain !
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Mary! It's been ages. How was Scotland?
turns.phon: MÈ-ri. its binn ÉÏ-djiz. HAÔ ouoz SKOT-leund
turns.native: Marie ! Ça fait une éternité. Comment c'était, l'Écosse ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Amazing, but it didn't start well. We missed the train on the first day.
turns.phon: eu-MÉÏ-zing, beut it DI-deunt START OUÈL. oui MIST ze TRÉÏN onn ze FEURST DÉÏ
turns.native: Génial, mais ça a mal commencé. On a raté le train le premier jour.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Oh no! What did you do?
turns.phon: ô NÔ. ouot did you DOU
turns.native: Oh non ! Qu'est-ce que vous avez fait ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: We rented a car. At that moment, it started to rain, of course. I was so worried.
turns.phon: oui RÈN-tid eu KAR. at zat MÔ-meunt, it STAR-tid tou RÉÏN, ov KORSS. aï ouoz sô OUEU-rid
turns.native: On a loué une voiture. À ce moment-là, il s'est mis à pleuvoir, bien sûr. J'étais tellement inquiète.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: I can imagine. Was it worth it in the end?
turns.phon: aï kann i-MA-djinn. ouoz it WEURTH it inn zi ÈND
turns.native: J'imagine. Ça valait le coup, au final ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Yes! The lakes were beautiful. On the one hand it rained every day, on the other we had the roads to ourselves.
turns.phon: YÈS. ze LÉÏKS weur BYOU-ti-foul. onn ze OUANN HAND it RÉÏND ÈV-ri DÉÏ, onn zi EU-zeur oui had ze RÔDZ tou aô-eur-SÈLVZ
turns.native: Oui ! Les lacs étaient magnifiques. D'un côté il a plu tous les jours, de l'autre on avait les routes pour nous.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Do you mean you'd go back?
turns.phon: dou you MIN youd GÔ BAK
turns.native: Tu veux dire que tu y retournerais ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Definitely, but in summer. Anyway, it all ended well. By the way, did you find a flat?
turns.phon: DÈ-fi-nit-li, beut inn SEU-meur. È-ni-ouéï, it OL ÈN-did OUÈL. baï ze OUÉÏ, did you FAÏND eu FLAT
turns.native: Carrément, mais en été. Enfin bref, tout s'est bien terminé. Au fait, tu as trouvé un appartement ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Not yet, I'm still looking. I'll tell you next time. Well, I have to go. See you soon!
turns.phon: not YÈT, aïm stil LOU-king. aïl TÈL you NÈKST TAÏM. OUÈL, aï hav tou GÔ. SI you SOUN
turns.native: Pas encore, je cherche toujours. Je te raconterai la prochaine fois. Bon, je dois y aller. À bientôt !
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: It was lovely to see you. Say hello to your family!
turns.phon: it ouoz LEUV-li tou SI you. SÉÏ hè-LÔ tou yor FA-mi-li
turns.native: C'était un plaisir de te voir. Dis bonjour à ta famille !
turns.speaker: B

turns.phon: sin pro-BLÉ-ma, lé én-BI-o oun ko-RRÉ-o
turns.native: Pas de problème, je vous envoie un e-mail.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Marta, ¿tienes un momento?
turns.phon: MAR-ta, TIÉ-nés oun mo-MÉN-to
turns.native: Marta, tu as un moment ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Sí, dime.
turns.phon: SI, DI-mé
turns.native: Oui, dis-moi.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Necesito dos días más para terminar el informe.
turns.phon: né-ssé-SSI-to dos DI-as MAS PA-ra tér-mi-NAR él in-FOR-mé
turns.native: J'ai besoin de deux jours de plus pour finir le rapport.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: ¿Por qué? El plazo es mañana.
turns.phon: por KÉ. él PLA-sso és ma-GNA-na
turns.native: Pourquoi ? Le délai, c'est demain.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Es que el cliente cambió los datos ayer.
turns.phon: és ké él KLIÉN-té kam-BIO los DA-tos a-YÉR
turns.native: C'est que le client a changé les données hier.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Vale, pero solo si lo entregas el jueves por la mañana.
turns.phon: BA-lé, PÉ-ro SSO-lo si lo én-TRÉ-gas él KHOUÉ-bés por la ma-GNA-na
turns.native: D'accord, mais seulement si tu le rends jeudi matin.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Sí, te lo prometo. Si termino antes, te lo envío.
turns.phon: SI, té lo pro-MÉ-to. si tér-MI-no AN-tés, té lo én-BI-o
turns.native: Oui, je te le promets. Si je finis avant, je te l'envoie.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: De acuerdo. Lo siento, pero no puedo darte más tiempo.
turns.phon: dé a-KOUÉR-do. lo SSIÉN-to, PÉ-ro no POUÉ-do DAR-té mas TIÉM-po
turns.native: D'accord. Désolée, mais je ne peux pas te donner plus de temps.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Lo entiendo, gracias.
turns.phon: lo én-TIÉN-do, GRA-ssias
turns.native: Je comprends, merci.
turns.speaker: A

longestVariant.study: Si he entendido bien, la cita es con el doctor López, ¿no?
longestVariant.phon: si é én-tén-DI-do BIÉN, la SSI-ta és kon él dok-TOR LO-péss, NO
longestVariant.native: Si j'ai bien compris, le rendez-vous est avec le docteur López, c'est ça ?

longestTurn.study: En ese caso, le ponemos en el vuelo de mañana y le pagamos el hotel.
longestTurn.phon: én É-ssé KA-sso, lé po-NÉ-mos én él BOUÉ-lo dé ma-GNA-na i lé pa-GA-mos él o-TÉL
longestTurn.native: Dans ce cas, on vous met sur le vol de demain et on vous paie l'hôtel.

lastVariant.study: Es decir, la cita es el martes.
lastVariant.phon: és dé-SSIR, la SSI-ta és él MAR-tés
lastVariant.native: Autrement dit, le rendez-vous est mardi.

units.frame: Lo que quiero decir es que {s}.

firstVariant.study: Lo que quiero decir es que no estoy de acuerdo.
firstVariant.phon: lo ké KIÉ-ro dé-SSIR és ké no és-TOY dé a-KOUÉR-do
firstVariant.native: Ce que je veux dire, c'est que je ne suis pas d'accord.

lastVariant.study: Lo que quiero decir es que prefiero esperar.
lastVariant.phon: lo ké KIÉ-ro dé-SSIR és ké pré-FIÉ-ro és-pé-RAR
lastVariant.native: Ce que je veux dire, c'est que je préfère attendre.
Ça dépend.

firstVariant.study: Es más bien un problema de tiempo.
firstVariant.phon: és mas BIÉN oun pro-BLÉ-ma dé TIÉM-po
firstVariant.native: C'est plutôt un problème de temps.

lastVariant.native: C'est plutôt un malentendu.

firstVariant.native: Peut-être que le train arrive en retard.

lastVariant.native: Peut-être qu'il y a une autre solution.

firstVariant.native: Il se peut que j'arrive en retard.

lastVariant.native: Il se peut que je doive annuler.

firstVariant.study: Hay un problema: he perdido la maleta.
firstVariant.phon: AY oun pro-BLÉ-ma: é pér-DI-do la ma-LÉ-ta
firstVariant.native: Il y a un problème : j'ai perdu ma valise.

lastVariant.study: Hay un problema: no tengo la receta.
lastVariant.phon: AY oun pro-BLÉ-ma: no TÉN-go la rré-SSÉ-ta
lastVariant.native: Il y a un problème : je n'ai pas l'ordonnance.

lastVariant.phon: ké po-DÉ-mos a-SSÉR én ÉS-té KA-sso
lastVariant.native: Qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire dans ce cas ?

firstVariant.study: Si he entendido bien, tengo que volver mañana, ¿no?
firstVariant.phon: si é én-tén-DI-do BIÉN, TÉN-go ké bol-BÉR ma-GNA-na, NO
firstVariant.native: Si j'ai bien compris, je dois revenir demain, c'est ça ?

lastVariant.study: Si he entendido bien, la cita es con el doctor López, ¿no?
lastVariant.phon: si é én-tén-DI-do BIÉN, la SSI-ta és kon él dok-TOR LO-péss, NO
lastVariant.native: Si j'ai bien compris, le rendez-vous est avec le docteur López, c'est ça ?
J'ai mal au dos.
Excusez-moi, mon vol a du retard.

firstVariant.study: No estoy seguro de la hora.
firstVariant.phon: no és-TOY ssé-GOU-ro dé la O-ra
firstVariant.native: Je ne suis pas sûr de l'heure.

lastVariant.native: Je ne suis pas sûr de comprendre.
Il manque le tampon.

turns.study: Perdone, mi vuelo a París está cancelado. ¿Qué podemos hacer?
turns.phon: pér-DO-né, mi BOUÉ-lo a pa-RIS és-TA kan-ssé-LA-do. ké po-DÉ-mos a-SSÉR
turns.native: Excusez-moi, mon vol pour Paris est annulé. Qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Lo siento. Puede que haya otro vuelo esta noche.
turns.phon: lo SSIÉN-to. POUÉ-dé ké A-ya O-tro BOUÉ-lo ÉS-ta NO-tché
turns.native: Je suis désolé. Il se peut qu'il y ait un autre vol ce soir.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: ¿Y si no hay?
turns.phon: i si no AY
turns.native: Et s'il n'y en a pas ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: En ese caso, le ponemos en el vuelo de mañana y le pagamos el hotel.
turns.phon: én É-ssé KA-sso, lé po-NÉ-mos én él BOUÉ-lo dé ma-GNA-na i lé pa-GA-mos él o-TÉL
turns.native: Dans ce cas, on vous met sur le vol de demain et on vous paie l'hôtel.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Si he entendido bien, tengo que esperar aquí, ¿no?
turns.phon: si é én-tén-DI-do BIÉN, TÉN-go ké és-pé-RAR a-KI, NO
turns.native: Si j'ai bien compris, je dois attendre ici, c'est ça ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Más bien no. Puede ir al hotel y le avisamos por teléfono.
turns.phon: mas BIÉN NO. POUÉ-dé IR al o-TÉL i lé a-bi-SSA-mos por té-LÉ-fo-no
turns.native: Plutôt non. Vous pouvez aller à l'hôtel et on vous prévient par téléphone.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Vale. Lo que quiero decir es que necesito llegar antes del lunes.
turns.phon: BA-lé. lo ké KIÉ-ro dé-SSIR és ké né-ssé-SSI-to yé-GAR AN-tés dél LOU-nés
turns.native: D'accord. Ce que je veux dire, c'est que je dois arriver avant lundi.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Lo entiendo. Quizás hay una plaza esta noche; vuelva en una hora.
turns.phon: lo én-TIÉN-do. ki-SSAS AY OU-na PLA-ssa ÉS-ta NO-tché; BOUÉL-ba én OU-na O-ra
turns.native: Je comprends. Peut-être qu'il y a une place ce soir ; revenez dans une heure.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: De acuerdo, gracias.
turns.phon: dé a-KOUÉR-do, GRA-ssias
turns.native: D'accord, merci.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Buenos días. ¿Qué le pasa?
turns.phon: BOUÉ-nos DI-as. ké lé PA-ssa
turns.native: Bonjour. Qu'est-ce qui vous arrive ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Me duele la garganta y la cabeza desde hace dos días.
turns.phon: mé DOUÉ-lé la gar-GAN-ta i la ka-BÉ-ssa DÉS-dé A-ssé dos DI-as
turns.native: J'ai mal à la gorge et à la tête depuis deux jours.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: ¿Tiene fiebre?
turns.phon: TIÉ-né FIÉ-bré
turns.native: Vous avez de la fièvre ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: No mucho. Un poco por la noche.
turns.phon: no MOU-tcho. oun PO-ko por la NO-tché
turns.native: Pas vraiment. Un peu le soir.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Puede que sea un virus. Le voy a recetar algo.
turns.phon: POUÉ-dé ké SSÉ-a oun BI-rous. lé BOY a rré-ssé-TAR AL-go
turns.native: Il se peut que ce soit un virus. Je vais vous prescrire quelque chose.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Si he entendido bien, no es grave, ¿no?
turns.phon: si é én-tén-DI-do BIÉN, no és GRA-bé, NO
turns.native: Si j'ai bien compris, ce n'est pas grave, c'est ça ?
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: No, pero es mejor descansar dos o tres días.
turns.phon: NO, PÉ-ro és mé-KHOR dés-kan-SSAR dos o trés DI-as
turns.native: Non, mais il vaut mieux vous reposer deux ou trois jours.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Hay un problema: mañana tengo que trabajar.
turns.phon: AY oun pro-BLÉ-ma: ma-GNA-na TÉN-go ké tra-ba-KHAR
turns.native: Il y a un problème : demain je dois travailler.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Le hago un justificante. En parte depende de usted: descanse.
turns.phon: lé A-go oun khous-ti-fi-KAN-té. én PAR-té dé-PÉN-dé dé ous-TÉD: dés-KAN-ssé
turns.native: Je vous fais un certificat. En partie, ça dépend de vous : reposez-vous.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Gracias, doctor.
turns.phon: GRA-ssias, dok-TOR
turns.native: Merci, docteur.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Buenos días, vengo a renovar mi tarjeta.
turns.phon: BOUÉ-nos DI-as, BÉN-go a rré-no-BAR mi tar-KHÉ-ta
turns.native: Bonjour, je viens renouveler ma carte.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: A ver… Falta un documento: el justificante de domicilio.
turns.phon: a BÉR… FAL-ta oun do-kou-MÉN-to: él khous-ti-fi-KAN-té dé do-mi-SSI-lio
turns.native: Voyons… Il manque un document : le justificatif de domicile.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Es decir, ¿una factura de la luz?
turns.phon: és dé-SSIR, OU-na fak-TOU-ra dé la LOUSS
turns.native: Autrement dit, une facture d'électricité ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Sí, o del agua.
turns.phon: SI, o dél A-goua
turns.native: Oui, ou d'eau.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Puede que la tenga en el móvil. Un momento… Aquí está.
turns.phon: POUÉ-dé ké la TÉN-ga én él MO-bil. oun mo-MÉN-to… a-KI és-TA
turns.native: Il se peut que je l'aie sur mon téléphone. Un moment… La voilà.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Perfecto. Pero no estoy seguro de la fecha: es de hace cuatro meses.
turns.phon: pér-FÉK-to. PÉ-ro no és-TOY ssé-GOU-ro dé la FÉ-tcha: és dé A-ssé KOUA-tro MÉ-ssés
turns.native: Parfait. Mais je ne suis pas sûr pour la date : elle a quatre mois.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: ¿Qué podemos hacer en este caso?
turns.phon: ké po-DÉ-mos a-SSÉR én ÉS-té KA-sso
turns.native: Qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire dans ce cas ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Más bien, tráigame una de este mes. Puede volver mañana sin cita.
turns.phon: mas BIÉN, TRAI-ga-mé OU-na dé ÉS-té MÉS. POUÉ-dé bol-BÉR ma-GNA-na sin SSI-ta
turns.native: Plutôt, apportez-m'en une de ce mois-ci. Vous pouvez revenir demain sans rendez-vous.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Si he entendido bien, vuelvo mañana con la factura, ¿no?
turns.phon: si é én-tén-DI-do BIÉN, BOUÉL-bo ma-GNA-na kon la fak-TOU-ra, NO
turns.native: Si j'ai bien compris, je reviens demain avec la facture, c'est ça ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: Exacto. Hasta mañana.
turns.phon: ék-SSAK-to. AS-ta ma-GNA-na
turns.native: Exactement. À demain.
turns.speaker: B

lastVariant.native: Quand ma fille est née, j'ai été très content.

firstVariant.study: Lo que más me gustó fue la gente.

lastVariant.study: Lo que más me gustó fue el paisaje.
lastVariant.phon: lo ké MAS mé gous-TO FOUÉ él pai-SSA-khé
lastVariant.native: Ce que j'ai le plus aimé, c'est le paysage.

firstVariant.phon: por SSIÉR-to, KO-mo és-TA tou MA-dré

lastVariant.native: Au fait, j'ai une nouvelle.

units.situation: Clarifier ce que l'autre veut dire

firstVariant.phon: o SSÉ-a, ké pré-FIÉ-rés ké-DAR-té, NO
firstVariant.native: Donc, tu préfères rester, c'est ça ?

lastVariant.study: O sea, que te parece caro, ¿no?
lastVariant.phon: o SSÉ-a, ké té pa-RÉ-ssé KA-ro, NO

lastVariant.study: Estoy de acuerdo con lo que dices.
lastVariant.phon: és-TOY dé a-KOUÉR-do kon lo ké DI-ssés
lastVariant.native: Je suis d'accord avec ce que tu dis.

firstVariant.study: A mí me parece que vale la pena.

lastVariant.study: A mí me parece que deberíamos hablarlo con calma.
lastVariant.phon: a MI mé pa-RÉ-ssé ké dé-bé-RI-a-mos a-BLAR-lo kon KAL-ma
lastVariant.native: Moi, il me semble qu'on devrait en parler calmement.

lastVariant.study: Al final, fue una buena decisión.

lastVariant.native: Finalement, c'était une bonne décision.

turns.study: ¿Al final qué vais a hacer con el piso?
turns.phon: al fi-NAL ké bais a a-SSÉR kon él PI-sso
turns.native: Finalement, qu'est-ce que vous allez faire pour l'appartement ?
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: No lo sé. Por un lado me gusta el barrio, por otro es muy caro.
turns.phon: no lo SSÉ. por oun LA-do mé GOUS-ta él BA-rrio, por O-tro és mouy KA-ro
turns.native: Je ne sais pas. D'un côté j'aime le quartier, de l'autre c'est très cher.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Es verdad, pero en las afueras perderíais mucho tiempo en el coche.
turns.phon: és bér-DAD, PÉ-ro én las a-FOUÉ-ras pér-dé-RI-ais MOU-tcho TIÉM-po én él KO-tché
turns.native: C'est vrai, mais en banlieue vous perdriez beaucoup de temps en voiture.

turns.study: Sí, antes vivíamos allí y llegábamos a casa muy tarde.
turns.phon: SI, AN-tés bi-BI-a-mos a-YI i yé-GA-ba-mos a KA-ssa mouy TAR-dé
turns.native: Oui, avant on habitait là-bas et on rentrait très tard à la maison.
turns.speaker: B

turns.study: Si te entiendo bien, piensas que es mejor quedarte.
turns.phon: si té én-TIÉN-do BIÉN, PIÉN-ssas ké és mé-KHOR ké-DAR-té
turns.native: Si je te comprends bien, tu penses qu'il vaut mieux rester.
turns.speaker: A

turns.study: En parte. Lo que quiero decir es que necesitamos más espacio.
turns.phon: én PAR-té. lo ké KIÉ-ro dé-SSIR és ké né-ssé-ssi-TA-mos mas és-PA-ssio
turns.native: En partie. Ce que je veux dire, c'est qu'on a besoin de plus d'espace.
